exercises.title: Maple Run's five Cs
exercises.intro: Each fact about Maple Run answers one of the five Cs. Match each fact to the C it speaks to.

items.text: Dana Reyes has 6 counted flips in the last 36 months, so she is Tier 2
items.why: Track record answers 'will they repay?' (T1). The 15% deal is excluded under CORE-BOR-15.

items.text: One $8,000 state tax lien, filed 2019, paid and released 2020
items.why: Credit history and background are Character. The lien is explained and released (C6).

items.text: Exit: lease at about $3,100 a month, then a DSCR refinance
items.why: There is no income during rehab, so capacity is the exit (T1).

items.text: Back-up exit: a sale with a projected flip profit of $57,275
items.why: A sale exit is a way to repay, so it is Capacity (T1; RD-RES-01 Role 2).
Cash in the deal is what the borrower loses if it fails (T1).

items.text: Full-recourse guaranty from Dana Reyes and Sam Okafor
items.why: A guarantor's own assets are a second source of repayment. We count them under Capital, not Capacity (T1; CORE-DOC-01).

items.text: As-is appraisal $310,000, and we hold a first lien
items.why: Value now and our lien position answer 'what do we recover?' (T1).
Value after the plan is part of Collateral; LTARV tests it (F-RES-02).

items.text: The Columbus rental market and Ohio law (SLT-OH-01)
items.why: Market and rules around the deal are Conditions (T1; C10).
The loan's own terms are part of Conditions (T1).

exercises.title: The loan life cycle
exercises.intro: Put the eight life-cycle stages in order. Each one carries the rules that govern it.

steps: Screen: purpose, borrower, property, state and OFAC (CORE-BP-01 to -04; CORE-BOR-01; CORE-KYC-01)
Term sheet: proposed amount, rate, points, term and conditions, not binding (CORE-PRC-01 to -03)
Underwrite: cash flow, value, sponsor, KYC and sizing, written up in the credit memo (CORE-VAL-01; CORE-KYC-01 to -07)
Approve: recommendation and a separate approval with conditions (CORE-AUTH-01 to -04; CORE-EXC)
Document and close: title for the full commitment, insurance, funding (CORE-DOC; CORE-CLS-06; CORE-INS-01, -04)
Service: payments, draws, reporting and monthly ratings (CORE-SVC-01 to -07)
Exit: payoff, extension or refinance, then lien release (CORE-SVC-01, -02)
Default, if needed: workout, foreclosure, REO (CORE-DEF-01 to -06)
order.why: For Maple Run: stages 1 to 4 come before closing on 15 Jan 2027. Draws in months 2, 4, 6 and 8 are servicing. Maturity on 15 Jan 2028 and the month-14 DSCR refinance are the exit. Default comes only if the exit fails (T3).

exercises.title: Route it to the right approver
exercises.intro: Check loan size, sponsor exposure, exceptions and triggers. The highest approver any of them needs makes the decision (CORE-AUTH-01).

start.q: Is it a related-party or employee loan, a Tier 0 ground-up loan, or a concentration breach (exposure above the sponsor's tier cap, CORE-CONC-01)?

size.q: Is the commitment above $2,000,000, or sponsor exposure above $5,000,000 (F-CORE-29)?

exceptions.q: How many policy exceptions does the loan need?

senior_box.q: Is it Residential, with a commitment up to $500,000 and sponsor exposure up to $1,000,000?

co_limit.q: Is the exception within credit officer limits: leverage +2.5 points, DSCR −0.05x, FICO −20 or liquidity −10% of requirement?

committee_limit.q: Is each exception within committee limits: leverage +5.0 points, DSCR −0.10x, FICO −40 or liquidity −25% of requirement?

new_state_res.q: Is this our first loan in a new state?

new_state.q: Is this our first loan in a new state?

senior.explain: Residential, up to $500,000 and $1,000,000 of exposure, with no exceptions (CORE-AUTH-01). The approver cannot be the underwriter of record.

credit_officer.explain: Up to $2,000,000 and $5,000,000 of exposure, with at most one exception inside credit officer limits (CORE-AUTH-01). Exceptions are approved before closing (CORE-EXC-01).

committee.explain: Committee takes loans above $2,000,000, exposure above $5,000,000, up to two exceptions inside its limits, and any concentration breach or other trigger (CORE-AUTH-01; CORE-CONC-01).

decline.explain: Beyond committee limits no one has authority, so the loan is declined (CORE-AUTH-01).

cases.text: Maple Run: $340,000 Residential loan, no exceptions. Harborline has no other loans with us. Dana Reyes is Tier 2 (cap $7,500,000). We already lend in Ohio.
Cedar Court: $5,140,000 commitment. Marcus Hale is Tier 1, capped at $3,000,000 of exposure.
A $1,800,000 multifamily loan to a Tier 2 sponsor with no other loans with us. No exceptions, in a state where we already lend.
A $450,000 Residential loan that needs one LTV exception of 2 points. Exposure is $450,000, in a state where we already lend.
Maple Run at 90% LTC ($360,000) for Tier 2, whose LTC cap is 85% (RES-FF-03). That is one leverage exception of 5 points. We already lend in Ohio.
